channel.title: ToolDune
channel.description: Free online tools: countdown timers, calculators, unit converters, text tools and generators.

item.title: Donation Deadline Calculator - Real Cost, Tax Math and December 31
item.description: Your gift amount and bracket give the real after-tax cost, the days left this year, and the receipt rules - plus the bunching move most filers never hear about. Free.

item.title: Holiday Tipping Calculator - Year-End Budget Split by Recipient
item.description: Your year-end tipping budget splits across weekly regulars and occasional helpers - with the USPS cap, the teacher rules and the frequency-beats-warmth principle. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Daylight Hours Calculator - Day Length by Date and Latitude
item.description: Any date plus your latitude gives the exact day length, the seasonal longest and shortest, and minutes gained or lost per day - with the winter-light honesty note. Free.

item.title: Humidifier Size Calculator - Gallons Per Day for Your Room
item.description: Room area, ceiling height and how leaky the room is give the gallons-per-day rating to shop for - plus winter electricity and honest tank-refill math. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Furnace Filter Calculator - Size Decoder, Yearly Cost and MERV Honesty
item.description: Decode the size on the frame, price a year of filters at your change interval, and get the MERV answer without the filtration-fear upsell. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Christmas Lights Cost Calculator - LED vs Incandescent Season Bill
item.description: Strings, hours and your electric rate become the real season bill - and the exact dollar figure an LED swap saves before you climb the ladder. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Car Battery Cold Weather Test - Will It Start Tomorrow Morning?
item.description: Battery age, your climate history and the overnight low give the starting power left, the cold-cut capacity curve and a plain verdict: start, test, or replace. Free.

item.title: Antifreeze Mix Calculator - Concentrate, Water and Freeze Protection
item.description: Cooling system capacity plus target mix gives quarts of concentrate and distilled water - with the freeze chart and the 70% trap the shelf never mentions. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Tire Pressure Temperature Calculator - How Much PSI the Cold Takes
item.description: The first cold night costs your tires real PSI - see the exact loss, what the gauge should read today, and why the TPMS light loves November mornings. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Roth vs Traditional 401k Calculator - Which Wins After All Taxes
item.description: Same growth, different tax year: see the final after-tax value of Roth versus Traditional at your rates, and why the verdict reduces to one question. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Thanksgiving Dinner Cost Calculator - Total and Per Guest
item.description: Guests, turkey price and sides style become a total dinner bill, a per-guest figure and the exact turkey weight to buy. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Social Security Break Even Calculator - Claim at 62, 67 or 70?
item.description: Your birth year and benefit estimate become the real monthly check at each claiming age - with the 62-vs-70 break-even age and the earnings-test warning. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: HSA Contribution Calculator - 2026 Limits, Tax Savings and the Cap
item.description: The 2026 HSA limits by coverage and age, your real tax saving with payroll tax skipped, and a warning the moment you cross the cap. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: FSA Calculator - Tax Savings, Per-Paycheck Cost and Use-or-Lose Risk
item.description: Your FSA election becomes real tax saved at your bracket plus payroll tax, the per-paycheck dent, and exactly how much sits at use-or-lose risk. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: HDHP vs PPO Calculator - Which Health Plan Wins on Total Cost
item.description: Premiums, deductibles, expected care and the employer HSA seed become one verdict: which plan wins this year and where the crossover sits. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Electric vs Gas Heating Cost - Compare per Million BTU at Your Rates
item.description: Your electric and gas prices, furnace efficiency and heat pump COP become one verdict in dollars per million BTU - the honest way to rank heating fuels. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Generator Fuel Calculator - Gallons and Cost for Your Outage
item.description: Generator size, load and outage hours give the burn rate, total gallons, cost and cans to fill - with the refueling and backfeed rules that keep you safe. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: UPS Runtime Calculator - How Long Will a UPS Keep You Powered?
item.description: Enter your UPS size, the load it carries and battery age to estimate real runtime in minutes - and why the VA badge lies while the battery decides. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Power Outage Food Calculator - Is the Fridge Still Safe?
item.description: How long is food safe when the power is out? Hours out, freezer fullness and the fridge door give the federal 4-hour and 48-hour verdict: keep it, toss the fridge, or bin the thawed. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Generator Size Calculator - Running Watts Plus the Biggest Motor
item.description: What size generator do you need? Your running watts plus the largest motor surge give the right size in watts - with headroom and the two safety rules that outrank watts. Free, no sign-up.
